editDetails.howFilesAreNumbered: How files are numbered and where episode titles, descriptions and images come from. Changing this rematches only this show’s known files; watch history is kept.
editDetails.yourOwnTagsE: Your own tags, e.g. Not for kids
editDetails.onlyYouSeeThese: Only you see these. Use them to filter, build smart collections, or hide titles from a profile.
editDetails.unlockedUpdatedFromThe: Unlocked: updated from the internet on refresh
editDetails.lockedMovie: Anything you change is locked, so refreshing from TMDB won't undo it. Unlock a field to use the online value again.
editDetails.lockedSeries: Anything you change is locked, so refreshing from TMDB and TheTVDB won't undo it. Unlock a field to use the online value again.
editDetails.providerExplanation: The show’s details come from the library’s metadata provider, {{provider}}. Episode titles, descriptions and images come from the file episode order below.

editSeasons.locked: Anything you change is locked, so refreshes won’t undo it.

episodeOrdering.yourChoiceAlsoSets: Your choice also sets the server default
